mintAuthority.summary: HCHF is minted only when immutable HLiquity BorrowerOperations creates user debt against HBAR Troves. The HTS supply key decodes to fixed HCHFToken contract 0.0.6070122 rather than an external keypair, and that wrapper accepts mint calls only from fixed BorrowerOperations 0.0.6070094. The token has no admin, freeze, KYC, wipe, pause, fee, or metadata key. BorrowerOperations, TroveManager, StabilityPool, and PriceFeed have renounced ownership; HCHFToken has no Ownable interface.

controls.label: HLiquity HCHFToken and fixed BorrowerOperations mint path
controls.capDescription: No hard global supply cap. BorrowerOperations permits user debt only under the immutable 110% minimum collateral ratio, 150% critical collateral ratio, 1,780-HCHF minimum net debt, 20-HCHF gas compensation, and 0.5% borrowing-fee floor; HTS also applies its signed-int64 per-call bound.
controls.evidence: At Hedera block 100587413 (2026-10-01 07:20:31 UTC), HCHFToken getter calls returned BorrowerOperations 0.0.6070094, TroveManager 0.0.6070118, StabilityPool 0.0.6070108, and token 0.0.6070123. BorrowerOperations, TroveManager, StabilityPool, and PriceFeed returned owner() = 0. HCHFToken owner() reverted: its source has no Ownable interface, so the earlier assertion that all five returned zero was incorrect. Mirror Node metadata retrieved on 2026-10-01 reports no token admin, freeze, KYC, wipe, pause, fee, or metadata key; supply key 0a0518eabef202 identifies ContractID 0.0.6070122, also the treasury. All five contract admin keys are self-referential ContractID keys. Source restricts mint to immutable BorrowerOperations; pinned getters confirm the unchanged collateral parameters.

review.evidence: Current fixed-path getters and four Ownable owner() reads were verified at Hedera block 100587413 on 2026-10-01. HCHFToken is not Ownable and its owner() call reverts; it must not be described as having renounced ownership. Mirror Node token and contract metadata independently retain the fixed supply key, absent holder-restriction keys, and self-referential contract admin keys. BorrowerOperations parameters remain 110% MCR, 150% CCR, 1,780-HCHF minimum net debt, 20-HCHF gas compensation, and 0.5% borrowing-fee floor. Transaction-history searches returned empty pages with continuation links, so this review does not assert a complete absence of contract-update history. Immutable user-collateralized issuance remains the reviewed economic boundary; reconciliation is not applicable and no off-chain supervisor applies.
